purpose: Portable machine-readable DIAL project truth used to prevent context drift across agents, sessions and repository migrations.

rules: Do not infer current truth from historical documents when a supersession exists.
Do not downgrade a feature below an inherited evidence gate without an explicit evidence invalidation record.
Do not invent a new source of truth, payment engine, job engine, catalogue authority or delivery authority.
When context is incomplete, re-read the Context Bundle and registries before continuing.
At session handoff, record changed decisions, feature gates, evidence and unresolved items.
Conversation history is working memory only; durable project memory must live in repository Project Truth/evidence/handoff artifacts.
External plugins, MCP caches, connected apps and model-native memory are cache/advisory context only unless an approved record is promoted into Project Truth.
At Claude Code or Codex session startup, verify the approved plugin-profile version and automatically install missing required plugins through the harness native mechanism where permitted.

nonNegotiables.title: Key-late development
nonNegotiables.rule: Missing live API keys or partner credentials never block feature development or engineering tests; use fixture/contract/sandbox paths and keep live gates honestly open.

nonNegotiables.title: Zero-code key drop-in
nonNegotiables.rule: Adding real credentials later must require configuration only, not feature coding.

nonNegotiables.title: Evidence inheritance
nonNegotiables.rule: Accepted vertical-slice evidence survives repository migration and is not repeated merely because the repository changes.

nonNegotiables.title: Gate inheritance
nonNegotiables.rule: Green historical slices start at Integration Green; untested new features start at Thin Slice Required.

nonNegotiables.title: Frontend quality
nonNegotiables.rule: Generic AI-generated screens are prohibited; significant frontend work requires intentional design and visual evidence.

nonNegotiables.title: Wholesale donor porting
nonNegotiables.rule: Repositories designated PORT-WHOLESALE are copied wholesale into controlled import/quarantine, then customized to DIAL instead of cheaply recreated.

nonNegotiables.title: DIAL remains SoR
nonNegotiables.rule: Donor auth, payments, jobs, ledger, catalogue, delivery and other authorities never replace DIAL domain SoRs.

nonNegotiables.title: Feature Realization Contract
nonNegotiables.rule: A feature must map outcome, actors, screens, domain owner, data, state, API, events, integrations, security, tests and release gates.

nonNegotiables.title: Build broad launch selectively
nonNegotiables.rule: Branches may be Production Green or Certified Dormant without commercial activation.

nonNegotiables.title: No silent feature loss
nonNegotiables.rule: Refactors, repo migrations, donor imports and document rewrites cannot remove accepted requirements without an explicit decision record.

nonNegotiables.title: FixItNow wholesale
nonNegotiables.rule: FixItNow is the mandated wholesale application donor for Dial a Tech; preserve the mature application/UI, then replace donor SoRs with DIAL contracts. Licence/permission remains a production release gate.

nonNegotiables.title: Hybrid Tech sourcing
nonNegotiables.rule: Dial a Tech supports direct booking/matching/emergency dispatch plus an Opportunity Marketplace; post-award all modes converge into the same canonical DIAL Job/Job Reserve workflow.

nonNegotiables.title: Free expression of interest
nonNegotiables.rule: Qualified technicians may express interest/propose without a per-bid or pay-to-rank toll at launch; monetize successful/protected value instead.

nonNegotiables.title: Repository-resident project memory
nonNegotiables.rule: Durable DIAL memory lives in Project Truth, feature/evidence registries, active-work and handoff artifacts shared by Codex, Claude Code and other approved harnesses; conversation history is never the sole memory of a project decision.

nonNegotiables.title: Concise UI and human-readable identifiers
nonNegotiables.rule: User-facing screens avoid unnecessary helper text and never use raw UUIDs, hashes or long generated technical IDs as normal names/references; use meaningful titles and short public reference codes while keeping internal IDs internal.

nonNegotiables.title: Automatic development bootstrap
nonNegotiables.rule: Project memory, drift checks, local development credentials, hook installation and active session context are initialized automatically through normal install/dev entrypoints and Claude/Codex SessionStart hooks; developers must not depend on remembering a manual setup ritual.

nonNegotiables.title: Plugin and tool memory isolation
nonNegotiables.rule: Plugins, connected apps, MCP caches and model-native memories may optimize or advise but cannot silently write or override DIAL Project Truth, evidence gates or authority files.

nonNegotiables.title: Approved automatic plugin bootstrap
nonNegotiables.rule: Claude Code and Codex sessions must verify the versioned approved plugin profile and automatically install/verify missing required plugins using the current harness native plugin manager when permitted; unapproved substitutes are forbidden, optional plugins are task-gated, and user/admin OAuth approval is surfaced once without blocking repository runtime startup.

nonNegotiables.title: Agency only
nonNegotiables.rule: DIAL-owned/principal Spare inventory path is discarded; no DIAL_OWNED or owned COGS runtime path.

nonNegotiables.title: Tech WHT control
nonNegotiables.rule: Technician payout architecture must retain ITF263/30% WHT controls where legally applicable.

nonNegotiables.title: Official WhatsApp only
nonNegotiables.rule: Official WhatsApp Cloud API/Flows only; no Baileys or unofficial WhatsApp clients.

nonNegotiables.title: Maps stack
nonNegotiables.rule: MapLibre plus approved OSS routing/geocoding stack; donor map choices do not become DIAL SoR.

nonNegotiables.title: Delivery SoR
nonNegotiables.rule: DIAL packages/delivery owns delivery-job truth; Fleetbase or donor runtimes do not.

nonNegotiables.title: AI never writes money
nonNegotiables.rule: AI may classify/draft/recommend but cannot set a binding payable amount, post ledger entries or release funds.

nonNegotiables.title: Simulation cannot pay
nonNegotiables.rule: Commercial Simulation and Command Centre Simulated mode cannot mutate production money.
